contexts.text: By the New Earth, etc. in Ezekiel, nothing else can be signified than such a kingdom of the Messiah, AC 5044:end. AC 8468:2.
Concerning the Lord's Kingdom, which is the New Earth there.
That the New Earth or Holy Land = the Lord's Kingdom, and also a New Church, which is the Lord's Kingdom on earth. References.
Concerning the New Heaven and the New Earth. General article.
By a New Earth is meant a New Church on earth. Explained. LJ 3, Explained. DLord 62.
By the New Earth is meant... the earth of that Heaven...
The New Earth = the Church where men are, which will be new.
The New Earth () = the external Church.
